newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK & Shanghai Hotels said planning rights issue.
newsitem.headline: HK & Shanghai Hotels said planning rights issue.

text.p: Hong Kong stock market sources said Hong Kong and Shanghai Hotels Ltd was expected to launch a rights issue consisting of one rights share for 12 existing shares.
Market sources said they expected the rights shares to carry warrants but no details were available.
A Hong Kong and Shanghai Hotels spokeswoman declined to comment but said the company was expected to issue a news release later.
Trading in the shares of the hotel group was suspended at the company's request ahead of the afternoon session pending an announcement.
The stock last traded at HK$13.85 per share.
